Defines the data structures for parsing Fedora security update XML feeds, mapping update advisory information including packages, references, and CVE identifiers.

## Key Components

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `Reference` | Advisory reference link with href, ID, title, and type attributes |
| `Package` | Affected RPM package metadata including name, version, release, epoch, and architecture |
| `Issued` | Timestamp struct for when an advisory was originally issued |
| `Updated` | Timestamp struct for when an advisory was last updated |
| `UpdateInfo` | Core advisory record containing severity, description, packages, CVEs, and references |
| `Updates` | Top-level container holding a list of `UpdateInfo` entries parsed from XML |

## Usage Example

```go
package main

import (
    "encoding/xml"
    "fmt"
    "os"

    "github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/path/to/fedora"
)

func main() {
    data, _ := os.ReadFile("updateinfo.xml")

    var updates fedora.Updates
    if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &updates); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }

    for _, info := range updates.UpdateList {
        fmt.Printf("Advisory: %s | Severity: %s\n", info.ID, info.Severity)
        for _, pkg := range info.Packages {
            fmt.Printf("  Package: %s-%s-%s.%s\n",
                pkg.Name, pkg.Version, pkg.Release, pkg.Arch)
        }
        for _, ref := range info.References {
            fmt.Printf("  CVE Ref: %s (%s)\n", ref.ID, ref.Href)
        }
    }
}
```

## Notes

- Both XML and JSON tags are defined, supporting dual serialization formats
- `UpdateInfo.Packages` uses a nested XML path (`pkglist>collection>package`) matching the standard Fedora `updateinfo.xml` structure
- `CVEIDs` and `ModularityLabel` are JSON-only fields with no XML counterparts, intended for post-processing enrichment
